verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents a lightweight, dependency-free C/C++ runtime that ships as pre-built binaries. Community discussion says its loading-time improvements (the mmap change) were 'a huge win for usability.' Fast cold start itself is not documented or measured first-party, so only the lightweight-binary half of the story is strongly evidenced. missing for 10: first-party documentation of cold-start/model-load latency, measured startup benchmarks, independent hands-on confirmation that inference begins without multi-second waits.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins

citations.quote: Plain C/C++ implementation without any dependencies
loading time performance is a huge win for usability
